mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, client_id AS clientId, contact_name AS contactName, contact_position AS contactPosition, contact_phone AS contactPhone, wechat, email, qq, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM customer_contact

SELECT id, uuid, client_id AS clientId, contact_name AS contactName, contact_position AS contactPosition, contact_phone AS contactPhone, wechat, email, qq, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM customer_contact WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_contact ( uuid, client_id, contact_name, contact_position, contact_phone, wechat, email, qq, remark, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{clientId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPosition}, #{contactPhone}, #{wechat}, #{email}, #{qq}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
